integrity: Analytic proof supported by an independently runnable finite diagnostic script; finite tests do not certify an infinite-dimensional result.
scientific_limitations: Optimality is established for the specified three-parameter geometrically regular family; no conclusion for arbitrary nonmonotone weights. The fixed-parameter asymptotic is not uniform at parameter-square boundaries. Related classical similarity criteria establish existence but not the stated quantitative invariant; independent literature review remains needed.
title: Optimal similarity conditioning of geometrically regular shifts and its dilogarithmic crossover
